why: Rebuilds the right board with the wrong lives. `switchTo`'s `lives` argument is what a level ADVANCE carries -- the count that survived the level before it -- and on a retry after a loss that count is zero, so the rebuilt board is unplayable and the next death re-ends it. Practice builds with an independent full pool (`onLevelSelect`'s own "independent fresh lives"), and this is the only other site that builds a practice board. The descriptor, the identity and the run are all correct under this mutation, so only an assertion on the built lives can see it.
killedBy: startGameWith: canonical session identity at the production boundary Practice a practice RETRY rebuilds the level it was on, still as practice
